def: A broad field of creating intelligent machines, including ML, NLP, and Deep Learning.
Computer vision a subset of AI that enables machines to understand and interpret visual data, such as facia recognition or self driving cars.

AI capabilities include weak AI (Narrator AI), which can handle specific tasks such as speech recognition or streaming recommendations; strong AI (Superintelligence), which surpasses human cognitive abilities and may exist in the future; and supervised learning, which involves training models on labelled input

Training a model on labelled input output pairs to predict labels for unsese data. Unsupervised Learning Letting an algorithm analyze unlabelled data to discover hidden patterns or grouping automatically.
Training models through a system of trial, error, rewards, and penalties to optimize decision making.

Virtual assistants (Siri, Alexa), spam filters, and navigation applications. Healthcare Early disease detection, robotic surgery, and accelerated drug discovery. Transportation & Industry Autoonomous vehicles, fraud detection in banking, and automatmed manufacturing.
